housing.summary: No municipal rental portal; the private long-term market runs through national listing portals and local agencies. Leases (contratto di locazione) are commonly 4+4 years; deposit typically 1-3 months. Rents quoted in EUR. Register the lease with the Agenzia delle Entrate and provide a codice fiscale to sign.

items.name: Immobiliare.it
items.notes: National rental/sale listing portal covering Florence.

items.name: Idealista
items.notes: National rental/sale listing portal covering Florence.

items.name: Casa.it
items.notes: National listing portal covering Florence.

items.name: Casa Spa (Florence-area public/social housing)
items.notes: Public/ERP (edilizia residenziale pubblica) housing for the Florence metropolitan area is administered locally; no single verified official URL confirmed in this session.

banking.summary: No city-level banking authority. Newcomers open accounts with national banks operating branches in Florence. A codice fiscale plus valid ID and proof of address are typically required for a resident account. Amounts in EUR.

items.name: Intesa Sanpaolo
items.notes: Major national retail bank with branches in Florence.

items.name: UniCredit
items.notes: Major national retail bank with branches in Florence.

items.name: BNL (BNP Paribas)
items.notes: National retail bank with branches in Florence; exact URL not re-verified this session.

schools.summary: State-school enrolment is handled under the Italian national system (Ministero dell'Istruzione); the Comune di Firenze runs municipal nurseries (nidi 0-3), infant schools and school services. International/bilingual options exist but are more limited than Milan/Rome.

items.name: Comune di Firenze — Educazione (school services, nidi, iscrizioni)
items.notes: Municipal education services: nurseries, infant schools, meals and transport; fees in EUR. Compulsory-school enrolment runs through the national MIUR/Ministero dell'Istruzione portal.

items.name: International School of Florence / bilingual options
items.notes: International and bilingual private schools operate in the Florence area; no single verified official directory URL confirmed this session.

legal_admin.summary: Residence registration (residenza anagrafica) and civil-status admin are handled by the Comune di Firenze (Anagrafe). Non-EU nationals also process a permesso di soggiorno via the Questura; EU citizens staying over 3 months complete iscrizione anagrafica.

items.name: Comune di Firenze — Anagrafe / Servizi demografici
items.notes: Registry office: residence registration, identity card, certificates, AIRE. Appointment booking generally required.

items.name: Questura di Firenze (permesso di soggiorno)
items.notes: Immigration desk for non-EU residence permits; national information at the Polizia di Stato portal (poliziadistato.it). No verified city-specific URL this session.

items.name: Prefettura di Firenze
items.notes: Government office handling citizenship and immigration matters; no verified URL this session.

key_steps: register residence (residenza anagrafica) at the Comune
non-EU: apply for/collect permesso di soggiorno
EU citizens staying >3 months: iscrizione anagrafica

tax_finance.summary: Personal taxation is administered nationally by the Agenzia delle Entrate; the codice fiscale is the universal tax identifier. National IRPEF applies with regional (Toscana) and municipal (Comune di Firenze) surcharges. Local property/waste taxes (IMU, TARI) are handled by the Comune. Currency EUR.

items.name: Agenzia delle Entrate (Italian Revenue Agency)
items.notes: Codice fiscale issuance, income tax (IRPEF) and tax returns (modello 730 / Redditi PF).

items.name: INPS (social security)
items.notes: National social-security institution for contributions and benefits.

items.name: Comune di Firenze — Tributi (IMU / TARI)
items.notes: Municipal taxes on property and waste; amounts in EUR.

key_items: codice fiscale required for nearly all admin and financial actions
IRPEF national income tax plus regional and municipal surcharges
impatriati / inbound-worker tax relief may apply to qualifying movers

transport.summary: Urban and suburban bus service in the Florence area is operated under the regional Autolinee Toscane concession; Florence also has tram lines and regional/national rail via Trenitalia. Fares in EUR. Airport: Florence Amerigo Vespucci (FLR).

items.name: Autolinee Toscane (regional bus operator, 'at')
items.notes: Single Tuscan public bus operator serving Florence urban and suburban lines.

items.name: Trenitalia (regional/national rail)
items.notes: Regional and national rail; main station Firenze Santa Maria Novella.

items.name: Comune di Firenze — Mobilità (tram, ZTL, parking)
items.notes: Municipal mobility information including the tramvia network, limited-traffic zone (ZTL) and parking permits.

healthcare.summary: Public healthcare via the Servizio Sanitario Nazionale (SSN), locally administered by Azienda USL Toscana Centro for the Florence area. Residents register with the SSN (tessera sanitaria) and choose a medico di base after obtaining residence and codice fiscale; EU visitors use EHIC/TEAM for temporary cover.

items.name: Azienda USL Toscana Centro (local health authority)
items.notes: Regional public health authority for the Florence area: GP/pediatrician registration, clinics and services. URL not re-verified this session.

items.name: Azienda Ospedaliero-Universitaria Careggi
items.notes: Main university hospital serving Florence; no verified URL confirmed this session.
